author: CrunchLabs
description:
SUBMIT YOUR KID’S APPLICATION FOR MY NETFLIX SHOW!

Looking for experimenters and future engineers to join me at CrunchLabs Academy for my new show, SCHOOLED!
Build a solution to a real-life household problem and show your kid’s work in a 2-3 minute audition video. Get creative, use whatever materials you have, and blow my mind!
Tap the link below for the full details and submit your video application. 

http://crunchlabsacademy.com/

#CrunchLabs #Netflix #CastingCall #Schooled #MarkRober
title: Apply to enroll at my new school! - Principal Mark Rober
